## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and its user-visible behavior is documented.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Generated files, caches, logs, point clouds, and build output are excluded.
- [ ] No confidential flight data, locations, customer information, credentials, or private paths are included.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies are necessary and their licenses are compatible with MIT distribution.
- [ ] Camera calibration is not represented as validated without supporting provenance.
